AccessBreaker: A hacked access configurator, specialized to unlock and erase access from digital locks.
AccessBreakerUnlimited: A hacked access configurator, specialized to unlock and erase access from digital locks.
AccessConfigurator: Used to modify the access level requirements for airlocks and other lockable devices.
AccessConfiguratorUniversal: A modified access configurator used only by the mythical Administrator.
Acidifier: Melts you into a puddle of yuck!
ActionActivateDeathAcidifier: Activates your death-acidifier, completely melting you and your equipment
ActionActivateDnaScramblerImplant: Randomly changes your name and appearance.
ActionActivateEmpImplant: Triggers a small EMP pulse around you
ActionActivateFreedomImplant: Activating your freedom implant will free you from any hand restraints
ActionActivateHonkImplant: Activates your honking implant, which will produce the signature sound of the clown.
ActionActivateMicroBomb: Activates your internal microbomb, completely destroying you and your equipment
ActionActivateScramImplant: Randomly teleports you within a large distance.
ActionAIViewLaws: View the laws that you must follow.
ActionAnimalLayEgg: Uses hunger to lay an egg.
ActionAnimateSpell: Bring an inanimate object to life!
ActionAnomalyPulse: Release a pulse of energy of your abnormal nature
ActionArtifactActivate: Activate yourself, causing chaos to those near you.
ActionBibleSummon: Summon a familiar that will aid you and gain humanlike intelligence once inhabited by a soul.
ActionBorgSwapModule: Select this module, enabling you to use the tools it provides.
ActionChangelingDevour: Consume the essence of your victims and subsume their identity and mind into your own.
ActionChangelingTransform: Transform and assume the identities of those you have devoured.
ActionChangeVoiceMask: Change the name others hear to something else.
ActionChargeSpell: Adds a charge back to your wand
ActionConfigureMeleeSpeech: Set a custom battlecry for when you attack!
ActionCreateThrowingStar: Channels suit power into creating a throwing star that deals extra stamina damage.
ActionCritFakeDeath: Pretend to take your final breath while staying alive.
ActionCritLastWords: Whisper your last words to anyone nearby, and then succumb to your fate. You only have 30 characters to work with.
ActionDevour: Attempt to break a structure with your jaws or swallow a creature.
ActionDisguiseAnchor: For many objects you will want to be anchored to not be completely obvious.
ActionDisguiseNoRot: Use this to prevent your disguise from rotating, making it easier to hide in some scenarios.
ActionDragonsBreath: Spew out flames at anyone foolish enough to attack you!
ActionEnergyKatanaDash: Teleport to anywhere you can see, if your Energy Katana is in your hand.
ActionExplosionRune: Summons a rune that explodes if used.
ActionFireball: Fires an explosive fireball towards the clicked location.
ActionFireballIII: The fastest fireball in the west!
ActionFireStarter: Ignites enemies in a radius around you.
ActionFlashRune: Summons a rune that flashes if used.
ActionGhostBoo: Scare your crew members because of boredom!
ActionGoliathTentacle: Use your tentacles to grab and stun a target player!
ActionGravityJump: Activating the advanced propulsion system, you propel yourself a short distance in the direction of your gaze.
ActionIgniteRune: Summons a rune that ignites if used.
ActionItemRecall: Mark a held item to later summon into your hand.
ActionJumpToCore: Sends your eye back to the core.
ActionMechEject: Ejects the pilot from the mech
ActionMechOpenUI: Opens the control panel for the mech
ActionMimeInvisibleWall: Create an invisible wall in front of you, if placeable there.
ActionNinjaEmp: Disable any nearby technology with an electro-magnetic pulse.
ActionOpenStorageImplant: Opens or closes the storage implant embedded under your skin
ActionOpenUplinkImplant: Opens the syndicate uplink embedded under your skin
ActionPAIOpenMap: Open your map interface and guide your owner.
ActionPAIOpenShop: Install new software to assist your owner.
ActionPAIPlayMidi: Open your portable MIDI interface to soothe your owner.
ActionPolymorphJaunt: Melt into the Ethereal Plane for a quick getaway!
ActionPolymorphJauntII: Melt into the Ethereal Plane for an even quicker getaway!
ActionRatKingDomain: Spend some hunger to release a cloud of ammonia into the air.
ActionRatKingOrderCheeseEm: Command your army to attack whoever you point at.
ActionRatKingOrderFollow: Command your army to follow you around.
ActionRatKingOrderLoose: Command your army to act at their own will.
ActionRatKingOrderStay: Command your army to stand in place.
ActionRatKingRaiseArmy: Spend some hunger to summon an allied rat to help defend you.
ActionRecallKatana: Teleports the Energy Katana linked to this suit to its wearer, cost based on distance.
ActionRepulse: Pushes entities away from the user.
ActionRetractableItemArmBlade: Shed your flesh and reform it into a fleshy blade.
ActionRevertPolymorph: Revert back into your original form.
ActionSericulture: Weave a bit of silk for use in arts and crafts.
ActionSpawnMagicarpSpell: This spell summons three Magi-Carp to your aid! May or may not turn on user.
ActionSpawnRift: Summons a carp rift that will periodically spawns carps.
ActionSpiderWeb: Spawns a web that slows your prey down.
ActionStunRune: Summons a rune that stuns if used.
ActionSummonGhosts: Makes all current ghosts permanently visible
ActionSummonGuns: AK47s for everyone! Places a random gun in front of everybody.
ActionSummonMagic: Places a random magical item in front of everybody. Nothing could go wrong!
ActionSurvCameraLights: Enable surveillance camera lights near wherever you're viewing.
ActionToggleEyes: Close your eyes to protect your peepers, or open your eyes to enjoy the pretty lights.
ActionToggleFov: Toggles field-of-view in order to see what players see.
ActionToggleGhostHearing: Toggle between hearing all messages and hearing only radio & nearby messages.
ActionToggleGhosts: Toggle the visibility of other ghosts.
ActionToggleGuardian: Either manifests the guardian or recalls it back into your body
ActionToggleInternals: Breathe from the equipped gas tank. Also requires equipped breath mask.
ActionToggleJetpack: Toggles the jetpack, giving you movement outside the station.
ActionToggleJusticeHelm: Toggles the justice helm on and off.
ActionToggleKnuckleDustersStun: Toggles the duster's built in stun baton.
ActionToggleLight: Turn the light on and off.
ActionToggleLighting: Toggle light rendering to better observe dark areas.
ActionToggleMagboots: Toggles the magboots on and off.
ActionToggleMask: Handy, but prevents insertion of pie into your pie hole.
ActionToggleNinjaGloves: Toggles all glove actions on left click. Includes your doorjack, draining power, stunning enemies and hacking certain computers.
ActionToggleParamedicSiren: Toggles the paramedic siren on and off.
ActionTogglePhaseCloak: Toggles your suit's phase cloak. Beware that if you are hit, all abilities are disabled for 5 seconds, including your cloak!
ActionToggleRootable: Begin or stop being rooted to the floor.
ActionToggleSpeedBoots: Toggles the speed boots on and off.
ActionToggleSuitPiece: Remember to equip the important pieces of your suit before going into action.
ActionToggleWagging: Start or stop wagging your tail.
ActionTurnUndead: Succumb to your infection and become a zombie.
ActionVendingThrow: Randomly dispense an item from your stock.
ActionViewLaws: View the laws that you must follow.
ActionVoidApplause: Clap your hands and swap places with the target.
ActionVulpkaninGravityJump: Use your agile legs to leap a short distance. Be careful not to bump into anything!
AdminHypo: The ultimate application of bluespace technology and rapid chemical administration.
AdminPDA: If you are not an admin please return this PDA to the nearest admin.
AdvancedMineralScanner: A scanner that checks surrounding rock for useful minerals. It must be in your hand or pocket to work. This one has an extended range.
AdvancedMineralScannerEmpty: A scanner that checks surrounding rock for useful minerals. It must be in your hand or pocket to work. This one has an extended range.
AdvancedMineralScannerUnpowered: A scanner that checks surrounding rock for useful minerals. It must be in your hand or pocket to work. This one has an extended range.
AdvMopItem: Motorized mop that has a bigger reservoir and quickly replaces reagents inside with water. Automatic Clown Countermeasure not included.
AgentIDCard: A card necessary to access various areas aboard the station.
AirAlarmAssembly: An air alarm. Doesn't look like it'll be alarming air any time soon.
AirAlarmAssemblyXeno: An alien air alarm. Why are the wires pulsating?...
AirAlarmElectronics: An electronics board used in air alarms.
AirAlarmXeno: An alien air alarm. Hopefully they didn't breathe poison.
AirCanister: A canister that can contain any type of gas. This one is supposed to contain air mixture. It can be attached to connector ports using a wrench.
AirCanisterBroken: A broken gas canister. Not useless yet, as it can be salvaged for high quality materials.
AirGrenade: A special solid state chemical grenade used for quickly releasing standard air into a spaced area. Fills up to 30 tiles!

Chambered in .45, the lord’s caliber, it is generally considered too unwieldy for standard use but has become something of a status symbol among Nanotrasen officials. Feeds from .45 pistol magazines.
WeaponPistolViper: A common handgun illegally modified by the Syndicate. The Viper sports a selector switch between semi-auto and ‘rock and roll’. The standard sidearm for any soldier who fights under the three serpents. Feeds from .35 pistol magazines.
WeaponProtoKineticAccelerator: Fires low-damage kinetic bolts at a short range.

WeaponPulseRifle: A weapon that is almost as infamous as its users.

WeaponRevolverMateba: A modern revolver used by Nanotrasen’s elite, near mythical ‘Death Squad’ task force. A designated marksman rifle firing in 3-round bursts. The Estoc was designed as the Lecter’s long-range counterpart, equipped with an extended 20-inch barrel and telescopic sight.
Feeds from .20 rifle magazines.

Popular gas-operated combat rifle used heavily by Nanotrasen and SolGov. Operating in semi or fully automatic, its accuracy, stopping power, and reliability make it excel in all manner of environments.
Feeds from .20 rifle magazines.

The Experimental Lecter 8
An unreasonably expensive military grade assault rifle with integrated optic. 
Uses .20 rifle ammo.

An older bullpup carbine model, with an attached underbarrel grenade launcher.
Feeds from .20 rifle magazines.
